title: research-papers — Correction b, 3D Navier-Stokes regularity & AB-Cloud / Riemann zeta zeros
description: A research-papers repository by Iskhak Hamzatovich Isaev containing two independent research programs that converge on the universal polarization correction b ≈ 0.0785 from Kirchhoff point-vortex equations. Thread 1 (3D Navier-Stokes regularity): the correction b acts as a rotation angle (θ_b ≈ 7.07°) that stabilises the 3D Navier-Stokes equations without adding any dissipation — the velocity field is rotated around the vortex axis by R_b with R_b^T R_b = I, preserving energy while reducing the BKM blow-up criterion integral by a factor of 3.5×. Thread 2 (AB-Cloud & Riemann zeta zeros): the AB-Cloud — a 36³ non-Hermitian Hofstadter Hamiltonian whose phase pattern is dictated by the Riemann ζ-zeros — reproduces the GUE spacing statistics of ζ-zeros to KS p-values of 0.27–0.88, and the form factor K(τ) to L² distance 0.0127. A permutation test excludes randomness at Z = 14.10σ (p < 10⁻⁴⁴). The repository ships 14 PDF papers (EN/RU), 16 editable DOCX sources, 92 Python files, 3 Julia files, 4 LaTeX preprint sources, and pre-generated verification figures.
